Aisha Chen: Heads up — KestrelPay EBR is Tue 3/2. Need a consolidated deck + a 10-min exec ask. Renewal looks soft (~65%); we should surface risk drivers and proposed mitigation. Who can own which bits?

Diego Morales: I can grab usage & retention charts. Do we want top-3 metrics or a full dashboard snapshot?

Aisha Chen: Top-3 + 90/30 day trend, and one slide on cost per session. Also want an anchor NPS line.

Samir Patel: I’ll prepare a 30s demo clip showing the prefix cache improvement and the reduced latency. Can do slide + Loom by Mon EOD.

Emma W.: I’ll assemble the exec-facing deck and send invites. Who is presenting executive ask? Aisha do you want to lead?

Aisha Chen: Yep I’ll present the ask and risk mitigation. Diego you’ll own metrics, Samir demo, Emma slides + run order.

Calendar-Bot: Reminder: KestrelPay EBR scheduled Tue 2026-03-02 16:00 PT — 45 mins. Meeting link: https://meet.example/ebr-kestrelpay

Aisha Chen: Action items (quick):
- [Aisha] Exec ask + 1-slide TL;DR (due Mon 12pm)
- [Diego] WAU / retention / cost-per-session charts (Mon 5pm)
- [Samir] 30s demo + brief script (Mon EOD)
- [Emma] Final deck + run order, dry run slot (Mon 6pm)

Diego Morales: FYI, usage query takes ~20m but I'll include a small SQL snippet in the slide if needed.

Samir Patel: Uploaded draft demo + notes: https://drive.google.com/demo-kestrel. Will mock data labels to call out ROI.

Emma W.: Added slide template + run order to the deck: https://drive.google.com/kestrel-deck. Put presenters on slide 2.

Aisha Chen: Quick check — do we have any outstanding enablement asks (training, SSO docs) to include as risk items?

Diego Morales: They flagged SSO in last sync; CS ticket open. I’ll include ticket link and impact statement.

Samir Patel: No new platform blockers from my side. Demo environment ready.

Emma W.: Dry run at Mon 6:15 PT? 30m should be enough.

Aisha Chen: Sounds good. I’ll run the dry run and collate final ask. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Diego Morales: ACK — will drop charts into the deck by 5pm.

Samir Patel: Done — demo clip uploaded at 1767891367 and added to slide 4.

Aisha Chen: Reviewing now. If anyone sees gaps ping me here.

Calendar-Bot: Event updated: KestrelPay EBR — Dry run Mon 18:15 PT (30m).
